            id,
            () ->
                new MultiBiteSkewerItem(
                    new Item.Properties().food(food.build()),
                    null,
                    nausea ? new ResourceLocation("minecraft", "nausea") : null,
                    nausea ? 60 : 0,
                    animationProfile(id))));
